moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio catalog-kinetic-type-line-break-reflow, written here): Card 270 → 170 px wide (0.4–1.1 s, cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1)), 92 px tall, radius 8, drag handle 6 × 24 px on its right edge. Words MAKE IT MOVE, 26 px, left-aligned, line pitch 38 px. When the width crosses the fit threshold, the word that wraps moves FLIP from its old slot to the new one in 480 ms power2.out (x linear in progress k, y along k^0.35 so it drops early); a 1 px outline flashes on it (0.9 × sin πk). Reverse 2.5–3.2 s; loop 4.2 s. Params: độ rộng (270 → 170 px) · thời gian co (0.7 s) · thời gian trượt từ (0.48 s).
moworks.titleVi: Khung hẹp lại, từ cuối xuống dòng
